summary: Verified in the binary (d7ba1b76): init with the skill source missing in a repo that holds .pi exits 1 STOPPED_MIDWAY reason SKILLS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, retryable false, canon.yaml/.gitignore/AGENTS.md/.canon left written, meta.next[0] canon status --json (read) then canon skills install --json; init --dry-run with the same cause is exit 2 SKILLS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, nothing written; a batch [{},{providers:none}] is exit 1 BATCH_INCOMPLETE /0 with item 0 failed STOPPED_MIDWAY reason SKILLS_INVALID_ARGUMENT and item 1 skipped; canon schema --error STOPPED_MIDWAY and --errors list the same row with its reason; INIT_SKILL_INSTALL_FAILED is gone from the registry and from every consumer except the replacement table, the audit and the old-name guard. Note for readers: re-running canon init after the stop in an unchanged environment is a no-op that reports ok (verified: rerun ok true, code none) and does not repeat the install, so the stop's repeat is canon skills install, as meta.next says. Blast radius: only init moves; canon schema init lists STOPPED_MIDWAY, SKILLS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, SKILLS_FAILED and WRITE_FAILED. atip check L1 is met at the 1.1 claim; with a 1.2 fixture copy the only failures are claim and cursor work (meta.contractVersion, limit/cursor/all flagOnly) and the old SHOULD L1.one-meaning-values.
